basics.name: Romain Sickenberg
basics.label: IT Support Technician (N1/N2/N3)
basics.summary:
IT Support Technician with a Software Engineering background, covering user support and incident resolution from N1 through N3 across workstations, identity/directory services and networking.

Covers the full support chain: ticket triage and escalation in **Jira Service Management**, incident and problem management along **ITIL** lines, **Active Directory** and **Microsoft 365** administration, and hands-on workstation, printer and network troubleshooting.

Work authorization: Swiss Citizen. Available now.
